settings.subtitle: Bridgestone is the world's largest tire maker — and the one Calgary drivers reach for when they want quiet, predictable performance across every season. We stock the Blizzak WS90 (winter), Turanza QuietTrack (all-season), Potenza Sport (performance), and Dueler A/T ASCENT (all-terrain) at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend Bridgestone in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Bridgestone has been engineering tires since 1931 and runs the largest tire R&D operation on the planet. For Calgary drivers that translates into compounds that hold up to the chinook freeze-thaw and tread designs that don't get loud after the first winter.

The Blizzak WS90 is our top-selling dedicated winter tire, period. Multi-cell compound that bites on January black ice without going gummy in a chinook. If you want one tire all year — the all-weather Turanza WeatherPeak alternative is the CrossClimate2 from Michelin, but if you specifically want Bridgestone all-year touring, the Turanza QuietTrack is the quietest tire we install.

For trucks and SUVs, the Dueler A/T ASCENT with 3PMS rating handles BC mountain runs to Banff and gravel back roads east of Calgary toward Strathmore. Price-matched against any local Calgary competitor — book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Most common Bridgestone sizes in stock. Same-day install on confirmed bookings — price-matched against any local Calgary competitor.
settings.faq_1_q: What's the best Bridgestone tire for Calgary winters?
settings.faq_1_a: The Blizzak WS90 is our most-installed Bridgestone winter tire from October through April. Multi-cell compound stays grippy below -25°C, which matters on the side streets in NE and SE Calgary that don't get plowed first.
settings.faq_2_q: How much do Bridgestone tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_2_a: Bridgestone tires at Prince Tires range from $230 to $650 per tire depending on size and model. The Turanza QuietTrack starts around $250 in common 17" sizes; Blizzak WS90 starts around $250; Dueler A/T ASCENT runs $370+ for truck sizes.
settings.faq_3_q: Is the Dueler A/T ASCENT 3PMSF rated?
settings.faq_3_a: Yes. The Dueler A/T ASCENT carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) symbol, which means it meets Alberta's winter-tire law and the Hwy 93 / Trans-Canada Banff mandate from October through April.
settings.faq_4_q: Can I install Bridgestone tires same-day in Calgary?
settings.faq_4_a: Yes for most common sizes. We stock Blizzak WS90, Turanza QuietTrack, Potenza Sport, and Dueler A/T ASCENT in popular Calgary fitments. Trucks need a 60-minute slot — call (403) 452-4283 to confirm.
settings.faq_5_q: Does Prince Tires honour the Bridgestone warranty?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes. Bridgestone tires come with the manufacturer's standard treadwear and defect warranty (varies by model — Turanza QuietTrack carries an 80,000 km warranty). We process warranty claims directly with Bridgestone on behalf of customers.
settings.faq_6_q: What's the difference between Blizzak WS90 and DM-V2?
settings.faq_6_a: WS90 is the latest Blizzak passenger-car winter tire (sedans, crossovers, smaller SUVs). DM-V2 is the same Blizzak technology built for trucks and bigger SUVs — bigger tread blocks, higher load ratings. We stock both.
settings.calgary_richtext: Bridgestone Blizzak WS90 is our second-most-installed winter tire after Michelin — it's the one that takes 30 seconds to grip on a -25°C Cochrane morning. Turanza QuietTrack is a city-favourite for sedans on long Stoney commutes. For trucks, the Dueler A/T Ascent handles snow on Highway 1A and the gravel out to Bragg Creek without sounding like a buzz-saw on pavement.
settings.awards_text: World's largest tire manufacturer by revenue. OE supplier to Toyota, Ford, Mercedes-Benz.
settings.testimonial_quote: Blizzaks have been my go-to for 3 winters now. Calgary doesn't care what tire you have, but these care back.
